resume: The interest owed by a debtor who is in default on payment of a pecuniary debt.
title: Verzugszins in English: default interest · Neur.on
description: Verzugszins in English is default interest (intérêt moratoire, interesse moratorio): the definition in Art. 104 CO and the official term in four languages.
lead: Default interest is owed as soon as a debtor is in default on payment of a pecuniary debt, regardless of any proven loss. It is one of the most frequent terms in formal reminders and statements of account.
definition: Default interest is the interest that a debtor in default must pay on a pecuniary debt. The Code of Obligations sets it at 5% per annum, even where a lower rate was stipulated by contract. A higher contractual rate continues to apply while the debtor remains in default. Default interest differs from contractual interest, which is paid for the use of capital, and from damages, which compensate for actual loss.

exemple.de: Ist der Schuldner mit der Zahlung einer Geldschuld in Verzug, so hat er <mark>Verzugszinse</mark> zu fünf vom Hundert für das Jahr zu bezahlen, selbst wenn die vertragsmässigen Zinse weniger betragen.
exemple.fr: Le débiteur qui est en demeure pour le paiement d’une somme d’argent doit l’<mark>intérêt moratoire</mark> à 5 % l’an, même si un taux inférieur avait été fixé pour l’intérêt conventionnel.
exemple.it: Il debitore in mora al pagamento di una somma di danaro deve pagare gli <mark>interessi moratori</mark> del cinque per cento all’anno, quand’anche gli interessi convenzionali fossero pattuiti in misura minore.
exemple.en: A debtor in default on payment of a pecuniary debt must pay <mark>default interest</mark> of 5% per annum even where a lower rate of interest was stipulated by contract.

resume: The loss of the right to enforce a claim in court once the statutory period has expired.
title: Verjährung in English: prescription · Neur.on
description: Verjährung in English is prescription, not limitation: the ordinary ten-year period of Art. 127 CO and the exact term in the four languages of Swiss law.
lead: Prescription does not extinguish a claim. It prevents the creditor from enforcing the claim in court if the debtor raises the defence. That is why the date of any interrupting act is checked before anything else. English lawyers speak of limitation, but the Federal Administration's translation keeps the civil-law term prescription.
definition: Prescription is the passage of time that allows a debtor to refuse performance of a claim. Under the Code of Obligations, all claims prescribe after ten years unless federal civil law provides otherwise; shorter periods apply to certain claims. A court may not apply prescription of its own accord: the debtor must raise it. Debt enforcement proceedings or an acknowledgement of the claim interrupt the prescriptive period, and a new period then begins.

exemple.de: Mit Ablauf von zehn Jahren <mark>verjähren</mark> alle Forderungen, für die das Bundeszivilrecht nicht etwas anderes bestimmt.
exemple.fr: Toutes les actions se <mark>prescrivent</mark> par dix ans, lorsque le droit civil fédéral n’en dispose pas autrement.
exemple.it: Si <mark>prescrivono</mark> col decorso di dieci anni tutte le azioni per le quali il diritto civile federale non dispone diversamente.
exemple.en: All claims <mark>prescribe</mark> after ten years unless otherwise provided by federal civil law.

resume: Compensation for damage caused by non-performance or by an unlawful act.
title: Schadenersatz in English: damages · Neur.on
description: Schadenersatz in English is damages (dommages-intérêts, risarcimento del danno): compensation for loss under the Code of Obligations, in four languages.
lead: Damages compensate for loss actually suffered, so the loss must be proven and quantified. In Switzerland the German term is written Schadenersatz, without a linking s, and French uses a hyphenated pair of words, dommages-intérêts. In English, damage is the harm suffered and damages is the sum awarded.
definition: Damages are monetary compensation for loss. In contract, an obligor who fails to perform an obligation at all or as required must make amends for the resulting damage, unless they prove that they were not at fault. In tort, the obligation arises from an unlawful act committed wilfully or negligently. The person claiming damages must prove the damage, the causal link and, depending on the case, fault.

exemple.de: Kann die Erfüllung der Verbindlichkeit überhaupt nicht oder nicht gehörig bewirkt werden, so hat der Schuldner für den daraus entstehenden Schaden <mark>Ersatz</mark> zu leisten, sofern er nicht beweist, dass ihm keinerlei Verschulden zur Last falle.
exemple.fr: Lorsque le créancier ne peut obtenir l’exécution de l’obligation ou ne peut l’obtenir qu’imparfaitement, le débiteur est tenu de <mark>réparer le dommage</mark> en résultant, à moins qu’il ne prouve qu’aucune faute ne lui est imputable.
exemple.it: Il debitore che non adempie l’obbligazione o non la adempie nel debito modo, è tenuto al <mark>risarcimento del danno</mark> derivatone, a meno che provi che nessuna colpa gli è imputabile.
exemple.en: An obligor who fails to discharge an obligation at all or as required must <mark>make amends for the resulting damage</mark> unless he can prove that he was not at fault.

resume: A sum promised in advance in case the contract is not performed.
title: Konventionalstrafe in English: contractual penalty · Neur.on
description: Konventionalstrafe in English is contractual penalty (clause pénale, pena convenzionale): the penalty agreed in advance under Art. 160 CO.
lead: The contractual penalty is the Swiss counterpart to what common-law contracts call liquidated damages. It is agreed in advance, and the court may reduce it if it is excessive. The Federal Administration's translation says contractual penalty: liquidated damages and penalty clause are common-law concepts.
definition: A contractual penalty is the performance, usually a sum of money, that the parties agree will be due if the contract is not performed or is performed defectively. Unless otherwise agreed, the creditor may compel performance or claim the penalty, but not both. The penalty is payable even if the creditor has suffered no damage, which distinguishes it from damages. The court must reduce, at its discretion, any penalty that it considers excessive.

exemple.de: Wenn für den Fall der Nichterfüllung oder der nicht richtigen Erfüllung eines Vertrages eine <mark>Konventionalstrafe</mark> versprochen ist, so ist der Gläubiger mangels anderer Abrede nur berechtigt, entweder die Erfüllung oder die Strafe zu fordern.
exemple.fr: Lorsqu’une <mark>peine</mark> a été stipulée en vue de l’inexécution ou de l’exécution imparfaite du contrat, le créancier ne peut, sauf convention contraire, demander que l’exécution ou la peine convenue.
exemple.it: Allorché fu pattuita una <mark>pena</mark> per l’inadempimento o l’imperfetto adempimento del contratto, il creditore non può pretendere, salvo patto contrario, che l’adempimento o la pena.
exemple.en: Where a <mark>penalty</mark> is promised for non-performance or defective performance of a contract, unless otherwise agreed, the creditor may only compel performance or claim the penalty.

resume: An undertaking towards a creditor to vouch for another person's debt.
title: Bürgschaft in English: contract of surety · Neur.on
description: Bürgschaft in English is contract of surety (cautionnement, fideiussione): the Swiss personal security, its formal requirements and the term in four languages.
lead: Under a contract of surety, one person answers for another person's debt. Its validity depends on strict formal requirements, so it must never be confused with an independent guarantee. In English, too, guarantee is not a synonym: the Federal Administration translates Bürgschaft as contract of surety.
definition: Under a contract of surety, the surety undertakes towards the creditor to vouch for performance of the debt owed by the principal debtor. The commitment is accessory: it follows the fate of the debt it secures, which distinguishes it from an independent guarantee. The Code of Obligations requires a written declaration and an indication of the maximum amount of liability. Where the surety is a natural person, a public deed is also required above a certain amount.

exemple.de: Durch den <mark>Bürgschaftsvertrag</mark> verpflichtet sich der Bürge gegenüber dem Gläubiger des Hauptschuldners, für die Erfüllung der Schuld einzustehen.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>cautionnement</mark> est un contrat par lequel une personne s’engage envers le créancier à garantir le paiement de la dette contractée par le débiteur.
exemple.it: Mediante la <mark>fideiussione</mark> il fideiussore si fa garante verso il creditore del debitore principale per il soddisfacimento del debito.
exemple.en: Under a <mark>contract of surety</mark>, the surety undertakes as against the creditor of the principal debtor to vouch for performance of the obligation.

resume: The transfer of a claim to a third party, without the debtor's consent.
title: Abtretung in English: assignment of a claim · Neur.on
description: Abtretung in English is assignment of a claim (cession de créance, cessione del credito): the transfer of claims under Art. 164 CO, in four languages.
lead: An assignment transfers a claim from the current creditor to a third party, without the debtor's consent. It is central to financing, receivables portfolios and security arrangements.
definition: The assignment of a claim is the act by which a creditor transfers their claim to a third party. The debtor's consent is not required, unless the assignment is forbidden by law or contract or prevented by the nature of the legal relationship. Under the Code of Obligations, an assignment is valid only if done in writing. Until the assignment is brought to the debtor's attention, the debtor is validly released by paying the former creditor in good faith.

exemple.de: Der Gläubiger kann eine ihm zustehende Forderung ohne Einwilligung des Schuldners an einen andern <mark>abtreten</mark>, soweit nicht Gesetz, Vereinbarung oder Natur des Rechtsverhältnisses entgegenstehen.
exemple.fr: Le créancier peut <mark>céder</mark> son droit à un tiers sans le consentement du débiteur, à moins que la cession n’en soit interdite par la loi, la convention ou la nature de l’affaire.
exemple.it: Il creditore può <mark>cedere</mark> ad altri il suo credito anche senza il consenso del debitore, se non vi osta la legge, la convenzione o la natura del rapporto giuridico.
exemple.en: A creditor may <mark>assign</mark> a claim to which he is entitled to a third party without the debtor’s consent unless the assignment is forbidden by law or contract or prevented by the nature of the legal relationship.

resume: The clause that prevents an employee from competing with their former employer.
title: Konkurrenzverbot in English: non-compete clause · Neur.on
description: Konkurrenzverbot is the prohibition of competition, known in contracts as a non-compete clause: the rules of Swiss employment law, in four languages.
lead: A non-compete clause restricts the employee's activity after the employment ends. Swiss law requires it to be in writing and appropriately restricted with regard to place, time and scope. The Code of Obligations calls it a prohibition of competition; non-compete clause is contract usage, not the statutory term.
definition: A prohibition of competition is a written undertaking by which an employee with capacity to act agrees to refrain from competing with the employer after the employment contract has ended. It is binding only where the employment gives the employee knowledge of the employer's clientele or of manufacturing and trade secrets. The use of that knowledge must also be capable of causing the employer substantial harm. The court may restrict an excessive prohibition.

exemple.de: Das <mark>Konkurrenzverbot</mark> ist nur verbindlich, wenn das Arbeitsverhältnis dem Arbeitnehmer Einblick in den Kundenkreis oder in Fabrikations- und Geschäftsgeheimnisse gewährt und die Verwendung dieser Kenntnisse den Arbeitgeber erheblich schädigen könnte.
exemple.fr: La <mark>prohibition de faire concurrence</mark> n’est valable que si les rapports de travail permettent au travailleur d’avoir connaissance de la clientèle ou de secrets de fabrication ou d’affaires de l’employeur et si l’utilisation de ces renseignements est de nature à causer à l’employeur un préjudice sensible.
exemple.it: Il <mark>divieto di concorrenza</mark> è valido soltanto se il rapporto di lavoro permette al lavoratore di avere cognizioni della clientela o dei segreti di fabbricazione e d’affari e se l’uso di tali conoscenze possa cagionare al datore di lavoro un danno considerevole.
exemple.en: The <mark>prohibition of competition</mark> is binding only where the employment relationship allows the employee to have knowledge of the employer’s clientele or manufacturing and trade secrets and where the use of such knowledge might cause the employer substantial harm.

resume: Hours worked beyond the working time agreed in the contract.
title: Überstunden in English: overtime · Neur.on
description: Überstunden in English is overtime (heures de travail supplémentaires, lavoro straordinario): Art. 321c CO and how it differs from Überzeit.
lead: Overtime means the hours worked beyond the working time agreed in the contract. Swiss German distinguishes Überstunden from Überzeit, a concept of the Employment Act: two words, two regimes, two legal bases. In English both are usually called overtime, so the translation must make clear which one is meant.
definition: Overtime means hours worked beyond those envisaged under the employment contract or provided for by custom, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract. The employee must perform overtime to the extent that they are able and may conscionably be expected to do so. With the employee's agreement, overtime may be compensated by time off in lieu of at least equal length. Otherwise it is paid with a supplement of at least one quarter, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

exemple.de: Im Einverständnis mit dem Arbeitnehmer kann der Arbeitgeber die <mark>Überstundenarbeit</mark> innert eines angemessenen Zeitraumes durch Freizeit von mindestens gleicher Dauer ausgleichen.
exemple.fr: L’employeur peut, avec l’accord du travailleur, compenser les <mark>heures de travail supplémentaires</mark> par un congé d’une durée au moins égale, qui doit être accordé au cours d’une période appropriée.
exemple.it: Con il consenso del lavoratore, il datore di lavoro può compensare il <mark>lavoro straordinario</mark>, entro un periodo adeguato, mediante un congedo di durata almeno corrispondente.
exemple.en: In consultation with the employee, the employer may compensate him within an appropriate period for the <mark>overtime</mark> worked by granting him time off in lieu of at least equal length.

resume: A company that is liable for its obligations only to the extent of its own assets.
title: Aktiengesellschaft: company limited by shares · Neur.on
description: Aktiengesellschaft in English is company limited by shares (société anonyme, società anonima), not plc or corporation: a common Swiss company form.
lead: The company limited by shares is one of the most common company forms in Switzerland. Its abbreviation follows the language of its entry in the commercial register: AG in German, SA in French and Italian. In English the abbreviation stays as registered, never plc or Inc.
definition: A company limited by shares is a company with a business name and a capital divided into shares. It is liable for its obligations only to the extent of its own assets. Shareholders are not personally liable for the company's obligations: they are only required to pay up their shares. The company acquires legal personality through entry in the commercial register and has three governing bodies required by law.

exemple.de: Die <mark>Aktiengesellschaft</mark> ist eine Kapitalgesellschaft, an der eine oder mehrere Personen oder Handelsgesellschaften beteiligt sind. Für ihre Verbindlichkeiten haftet nur das Gesellschaftsvermögen.
exemple.fr: La <mark>société anonyme</mark> est une société de capitaux que forment une ou plusieurs personnes ou sociétés commerciales. Ses dettes ne sont garanties que par l’actif social.
exemple.it: La <mark>società anonima</mark> è una società di capitali cui partecipano una o più persone o società commerciali. Per i debiti risponde soltanto il patrimonio sociale.
exemple.en: The <mark>company limited by shares</mark> is a company in which one or more persons or commercial enterprises participate. It is liable for its obligations to the extent of the company’s assets.

resume: The supreme governing body of a company limited by shares, made up of its shareholders.
title: Generalversammlung in English: general meeting · Neur.on
description: Generalversammlung in English is general meeting (assemblée générale, assemblea generale): the supreme body of a Swiss company limited by shares.
lead: The general meeting of shareholders is the supreme governing body of a company limited by shares. Its notices, minutes and resolutions are among the documents most often translated in a multilingual setting. The Federal Administration's translation says general meeting, not general assembly.
definition: The general meeting brings together the shareholders and is the supreme governing body of a company limited by shares. It determines and amends the articles of association and elects the members of the board of directors and the external auditors. It also approves the annual accounts, decides on the allocation of profit and discharges the board members. Certain resolutions require a qualified majority. The minutes record the resolutions and the results of elections.

exemple.de: Oberstes Organ der Aktiengesellschaft ist die <mark>Generalversammlung</mark> der Aktionäre.
exemple.fr: L’<mark>assemblée générale</mark> des actionnaires est le pouvoir suprême de la société.
exemple.it: L’<mark>assemblea generale</mark> degli azionisti costituisce l’organo supremo della società anonima.
exemple.en: The supreme governing body of a company limited by shares is the <mark>general meeting</mark>.

resume: The body that manages a company limited by shares and determines its organisation.
title: Verwaltungsrat in English: board of directors · Neur.on
description: Verwaltungsrat in English is board of directors (conseil d'administration): the body that manages a Swiss company limited by shares, and its duties.
lead: The board of directors is responsible for the overall management of the company and for its non-transferable duties. The English term is familiar, but the duties attached to it are those set out in the Code of Obligations, not those of a common-law board.
definition: The board of directors is the managing body of a company limited by shares and comprises one or more members. It is responsible for the overall management of the company and determines its organisation. It organises the accounting and financial control systems, appoints and dismisses the persons entrusted with management, and exercises overall supervision over them. It also prepares the general meeting. These duties are non-transferable and inalienable.

exemple.de: Der <mark>Verwaltungsrat</mark> der Gesellschaft besteht aus einem oder mehreren Mitgliedern.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>conseil d’administration</mark> de la société se compose d’un ou de plusieurs membres.
exemple.it: Il <mark>consiglio d’amministrazione</mark> della società si compone di uno o più membri.
exemple.en: The company’s <mark>board of directors</mark> comprises one or more members.

resume: The body that audits a company's annual accounts.
title: Revisionsstelle in English: external auditor · Neur.on
description: Revisionsstelle in English is external auditor (organe de révision): the body that audits the accounts of a Swiss company limited by shares.
lead: The external auditor audits the annual accounts and reports to the general meeting. Depending on the size of the company, the audit is ordinary or limited, or the company may dispense with it. The English translation of the Code of Obligations says external auditor, not statutory auditor.
definition: The external auditor examines whether the annual accounts and, if applicable, the consolidated accounts comply with the law and the articles of association. The Code of Obligations distinguishes between the ordinary audit, required for publicly traded companies and for companies above certain thresholds, and the limited audit. With the consent of all shareholders, small companies may dispense with the limited audit.

exemple.de: Folgende Gesellschaften müssen ihre Jahresrechnung und gegebenenfalls ihre Konzernrechnung durch eine <mark>Revisionsstelle</mark> ordentlich prüfen lassen: 1. Publikumsgesellschaften; als solche gelten Gesellschaften, die: a. Beteiligungspapiere an einer Börse kotiert haben, b. Anleihensobligationen ausstehend haben, c. mindestens 20 Prozent der Aktiven oder des Umsatzes zur Konzernrechnung einer Gesellschaft nach Buchstabe a oder b beitragen; 2. Gesellschaften, die zwei der nachstehenden Grössen in zwei aufeinander folgenden Geschäftsjahren überschreiten: a. Bilanzsumme von 20 Millionen Franken, b. Umsatzerlös von 40 Millionen Franken, c. 250 Vollzeitstellen im Jahresdurchschnitt; 3. Gesellschaften, die zur Erstellung einer Konzernrechnung verpflichtet sind.
exemple.fr: Les sociétés suivantes sont tenues de soumettre leurs comptes annuels et, le cas échéant, leurs comptes consolidés au contrôle ordinaire d’un <mark>organe de révision</mark>: 1. les sociétés ouvertes au public, soit les sociétés: a. qui ont des titres de participation cotés en bourse, b. qui sont débitrices d’un emprunt par obligations, c. dont les actifs ou le chiffre d’affaires représentent 20 % au moins des actifs ou du chiffre d’affaires des comptes consolidés d’une société au sens des let. a et b; 2. les sociétés qui, au cours de deux exercices successifs, dépassent deux des valeurs suivantes: a. total du bilan: 20 millions de francs, b. chiffre d’affaires: 40 millions de francs, c. effectif: 250 emplois à plein temps en moyenne annuelle; 3. les sociétés qui ont l’obligation d’établir des comptes consolidés.
exemple.it: Le seguenti società fanno verificare mediante revisione ordinaria effettuata da un <mark>ufficio di revisione</mark> il loro conto annuale ed eventualmente il loro conto di gruppo: 1. società con azioni quotate in borsa; sono considerate tali le società: a. i cui titoli di partecipazione sono quotati in borsa, b. che sono debitrici di un prestito in obbligazioni, c. che contribuiscono almeno per il 20 per cento degli attivi o della cifra d’affari al conto di gruppo di una società secondo la lettera a o b; 2. società che oltrepassano, per due esercizi consecutivi, due dei valori seguenti: a. somma di bilancio di 20 milioni di franchi, b. cifra dʼaffari di 40 milioni di franchi, c. 250 posti di lavoro a tempo pieno in media annua; 3. società obbligate ad allestire un conto di gruppo.
exemple.en: The following companies must have their annual accounts and if applicable their consolidated accounts reviewed by an <mark>external auditor</mark> in an ordinary audit: 1. Publicly traded companies; these are companies that: a. have equity securities listed on a stock exchange, b. have bonds outstanding, c. contribute at least 20 per cent of the assets or of the turnover to the consolidated accounts of a company in terms of letter a or b; 2. Companies that exceed two of the following thresholds in two successive financial years: a. a balance sheet total of 20 million francs, b. sales revenue of 40 million francs, c. 250 full-time positions on annual average; 3. Companies that are required to prepare consolidated accounts.

resume: The public register that records Swiss legal entities.
title: Handelsregister in English: commercial register · Neur.on
description: Handelsregister in English is commercial register (registre du commerce, registro di commercio): the public register of Swiss legal entities and its effects.
lead: The commercial register makes the legally relevant facts about an entity public: business name, registered office, governing bodies, signatories. The extract from the register is requested in almost every transaction. In English, keep commercial register: Companies House is a British institution.
definition: The commercial register records and publishes legally relevant information about legal entities, in order to provide legal certainty and protect third parties. It is kept by cantonal offices under the oversight of the Confederation. Entry in the register confers legal personality on companies limited by shares and limited liability companies. Entries take effect on publication, and from then on third parties cannot claim to be unaware of them.

exemple.de: Das <mark>Handelsregister</mark> ist ein Verbund staatlich geführter Datenbanken. Es bezweckt namentlich die Erfassung und die Offenlegung rechtlich relevanter Tatsachen über Rechtseinheiten und dient der Rechtssicherheit sowie dem Schutz Dritter.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>registre du commerce</mark> est un ensemble de bases de données gérées par l’État. Il vise notamment à enregistrer et à publier les faits juridiquement pertinents concernant des entités juridiques en vue de contribuer à la sécurité du droit et à la protection des tiers.
exemple.it: Il <mark>registro di commercio</mark> è un insieme di banche dati tenute dallo Stato. Ha lo scopo, segnatamente, di registrare e di pubblicare i fatti giuridicamente rilevanti inerenti agli enti giuridici, così da garantire la certezza del diritto e la protezione dei terzi.
exemple.en: The <mark>commercial register</mark> is a network of state-run databases. Its primary purpose is the recording and publication of legally relevant information about legal entities, which serves to provide legal certainty and protect third parties.

resume: The enforcement procedure for the payment of a sum of money.
title: Betreibung in English: debt enforcement · Neur.on
description: Betreibung in English is debt enforcement (poursuite, esecuzione), not debt collection: the Swiss procedure to enforce a money claim, in four languages.
lead: Debt enforcement is a procedure specific to Swiss law, with no exact equivalent in common law. Its name differs in each of the three official languages, and so does the abbreviation of the Act that governs it: SchKG, LP, LEF. In English, Fedlex uses debt enforcement and DEBA, but only the German, French and Italian texts are authoritative.
definition: Debt enforcement is an enforcement procedure carried out to secure the payment of money or the provision of security. It is conducted by the debt enforcement offices at the creditor's request, and the creditor does not have to prove the claim at the outset. Depending on the debtor's status and the nature of the claim, it continues by way of distraint, proceedings to realise a pledge or bankruptcy.
source: Fedlex, Federal Act on Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy

exemple.de: Auf dem Wege der <mark>Schuldbetreibung</mark> werden die Zwangsvollstreckungen durchgeführt, welche auf eine Geldzahlung oder eine Sicherheitsleistung gerichtet sind.
exemple.fr: L’exécution forcée ayant pour objet une somme d’argent ou des sûretés à fournir s’opère par la <mark>poursuite pour dettes</mark>.
exemple.it: L’<mark>esecuzione</mark> ha per scopo di ottenere il pagamento di danaro o la prestazione di garanzie.
exemple.en: <mark>Debt enforcement</mark> is an enforcement procedure carried out to secure the payment of money or the provision of security.

resume: The document served on the debtor that starts debt enforcement proceedings.
title: Zahlungsbefehl in English: summons for payment · Neur.on
description: Zahlungsbefehl in English is summons for payment (commandement de payer, precetto esecutivo): the first step in Swiss debt enforcement, in four languages.
lead: The summons for payment is issued on receipt of the request for debt enforcement and served on the debtor. Service starts the ten-day period for filing an objection, so the date of service must be recorded to the day.
definition: The summons for payment is the document that the debt enforcement office issues on receipt of the request for debt enforcement and serves on the debtor. It contains the details of the request, including the creditor, the amount claimed and the document or grounds on which the claim is based. It requests the debtor to pay within 20 days, informs the debtor of the right to object within ten days and warns that the proceedings will continue if the debtor does neither.
source: Fedlex, Federal Act on Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy

exemple.de: Nach Empfang des Betreibungsbegehrens erlässt das Betreibungsamt den <mark>Zahlungsbefehl</mark>.
exemple.fr: Dès réception de la réquisition de poursuite, l’office rédige le <mark>commandement de payer</mark>.
exemple.it: Ricevuta la domanda d’esecuzione, l’ufficio stende il <mark>precetto esecutivo</mark>.
exemple.en: On receipt of the request for debt enforcement, the debt enforcement office shall issue a <mark>summons for payment</mark>.

resume: The debtor's declaration that stops the debt enforcement proceedings brought against them.
title: Rechtsvorschlag: objection in debt enforcement · Neur.on
description: Rechtsvorschlag in English is objection (opposition, opposizione): the declaration that stops Swiss debt enforcement proceedings, in four languages.
lead: An objection stops the debt enforcement proceedings: until it is set aside, the procedure goes no further. The German word has nothing to do with a proposal (Vorschlag), a classic false friend in this field. In English, avoid opposition: the Federal Administration's translation says objection to the summons for payment.
definition: An objection is the declaration by which the debtor contests the claim and stops the debt enforcement proceedings. It is made verbally or in writing, either immediately to the person serving the summons for payment or within ten days of service to the debt enforcement office. No grounds need be given. The creditor must then obtain the setting aside of the objection or bring an action on the merits.
source: Fedlex, Federal Act on Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy

exemple.de: Will der Betriebene <mark>Rechtsvorschlag</mark> erheben, so hat er dies sofort dem Überbringer des Zahlungsbefehls oder innert zehn Tagen nach der Zustellung dem Betreibungsamt mündlich oder schriftlich zu erklären.
exemple.fr: Le débiteur poursuivi qui entend former <mark>opposition</mark> doit, verbalement ou par écrit, en faire la déclaration immédiate à celui qui lui remet le commandement de payer ou à l’office dans les dix jours à compter de la notification du commandement de payer.
exemple.it: Se l’escusso intende fare <mark>opposizione</mark>, deve dichiararlo verbalmente o per scritto, immediatamente a chi gli consegna il precetto o, entro dieci giorni dalla notificazione del precetto, all’ufficio d’esecuzione.
exemple.en: If the debtor wishes to <mark>object</mark> to the summons for payment, he must do so immediately verbally or in writing to the person serving the summons or within ten days of service to the debt enforcement office.

resume: General enforcement against all of the debtor's distrainable assets.
title: Konkurs in English: bankruptcy · Neur.on
description: Konkurs in English is bankruptcy (faillite, fallimento), not insolvency: general enforcement, the bankruptcy estate and payment of creditors in Swiss law.
lead: Bankruptcy is general enforcement: all of the debtor's distrainable assets form a single estate that serves to satisfy the creditors jointly. It is declared by the court and given public notice. In Swiss law it also applies to companies, so insolvency, liquidation or winding-up are not substitutes in a translation.
definition: Bankruptcy is general enforcement declared by the court against a debtor who is, as a rule, registered in the commercial register. All distrainable assets belonging to the debtor when bankruptcy is declared, regardless of where they are located, form a single estate that serves to satisfy the creditors jointly. The bankruptcy administration realises the estate and distributes the proceeds according to the schedule of claims.
source: Fedlex, Federal Act on Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy

exemple.de: Sämtliches pfändbare Vermögen, das dem Schuldner zur Zeit der <mark>Konkurseröffnung</mark> gehört, bildet, gleichviel wo es sich befindet, eine einzige Masse (Konkursmasse), die zur gemeinsamen Befriedigung der Gläubiger dient.
exemple.fr: Tous les biens saisissables du failli au moment de l’ouverture de la <mark>faillite</mark> forment une seule masse, quel que soit le lieu où ils se trouvent, et sont affectés au paiement des créanciers.
exemple.it: Tutti i beni pignorabili spettanti al debitore al momento della dichiarazione di <mark>fallimento</mark> formano, dovunque si trovino, un’unica massa destinata al comune soddisfacimento dei creditori.
exemple.en: All distrainable assets belonging to the debtor at the time that <mark>bankruptcy</mark> is declared, regardless of where they are located, form a single estate (the bankruptcy estate) which serves to satisfy the creditors jointly.

resume: The measure that secures a debtor's assets in Switzerland ahead of enforcement.
title: Arrest in English: attachment in debt enforcement · Neur.on
description: Arrest in English is attachment (séquestre, sequestro), not arrest or freezing order: the grounds for attachment in Swiss debt enforcement law.
lead: An attachment freezes assets located in Switzerland before the claim has even been established. The German word Arrest does not mean the arrest of a person: it is a dangerous false friend in international cases. Sequestration and freezing order are no better, as they carry other meanings in common-law systems.
definition: Attachment is a protective measure that allows the creditor of a debt that is due and not secured by a pledge to have the debtor's assets in Switzerland attached. The court authorises it in the cases provided for by law. These include cases where the debtor has no fixed domicile, seeks to evade their obligations or does not reside in Switzerland. The creditor must then validate the attachment by debt enforcement proceedings or a court action.
source: Fedlex, Federal Act on Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy

exemple.de: Der Gläubiger kann für eine fällige Forderung, soweit diese nicht durch ein Pfand gedeckt ist, Vermögensstücke des Schuldners, die sich in der Schweiz befinden, mit <mark>Arrest</mark> belegen lassen: 1. wenn der Schuldner keinen festen Wohnsitz hat; 2. wenn der Schuldner in der Absicht, sich der Erfüllung seiner Verbindlichkeiten zu entziehen, Vermögensgegenstände beiseite schafft, sich flüchtig macht oder Anstalten zur Flucht trifft; 3. wenn der Schuldner auf der Durchreise begriffen ist oder zu den Personen gehört, welche Messen und Märkte besuchen, für Forderungen, die ihrer Natur nach sofort zu erfüllen sind; 4. wenn der Schuldner nicht in der Schweiz wohnt, kein anderer Arrestgrund gegeben ist, die Forderung aber einen genügenden Bezug zur Schweiz aufweist oder auf einer Schuldanerkennung im Sinne von Artikel 82 Absatz 1 beruht; 5. wenn der Gläubiger gegen den Schuldner einen provisorischen oder einen definitiven Verlustschein besitzt; 6. wenn der Gläubiger gegen den Schuldner einen definitiven Rechtsöffnungstitel besitzt.
exemple.fr: Le créancier d’une dette échue et non garantie par gage peut requérir le <mark>séquestre</mark> des biens du débiteur qui se trouvent en Suisse: 1. lorsque le débiteur n’a pas de domicile fixe; 2. lorsque le débiteur, dans l’intention de se soustraire à ses obligations, fait disparaître ses biens, s’enfuit ou prépare sa fuite; 3. lorsque le débiteur est de passage ou rentre dans la catégorie des personnes qui fréquentent les foires et les marchés, si la créance est immédiatement exigible en raison de sa nature; 4. lorsque le débiteur n’habite pas en Suisse et qu’il n’y a pas d’autre cas de séquestre, pour autant que la créance ait un lien suffisant avec la Suisse ou qu’elle se fonde sur une reconnaissance de dette au sens de l’art. 82, al. 1; 5. lorsque le créancier possède contre le débiteur un acte de défaut de biens provisoire ou définitif; 6. lorsque le créancier possède contre le débiteur un titre de mainlevée définitive.
exemple.it: Per i crediti scaduti, in quanto non siano garantiti da pegno, il creditore può chiedere il <mark>sequestro</mark> dei beni del debitore che si trovano in Svizzera: 1. quando il debitore non abbia domicilio fisso; 2. quando il debitore, nell’intenzione di sottrarsi all’adempimento delle sue obbligazioni, trafughi i suoi beni, si renda latitante o si prepari a prendere la fuga; 3. quando il debitore sia di passaggio o appartenga al ceto delle persone che frequentano le fiere ed i mercati e si tratti di crediti per loro natura immediatamente esigibili; 4. quando il debitore non dimori in Svizzera, se non vi è altra causa di sequestro, ma il credito abbia un legame sufficiente con la Svizzera o si fondi su un riconoscimento di debito ai sensi dell’articolo 82 capoverso 1; 5. quando al creditore sia stato rilasciato nei confronti del debitore un attestato provvisorio o definitivo di carenza di beni; 6. quando il creditore possieda nei confronti del debitore un titolo definitivo di rigetto dell’opposizione.
exemple.en: The creditor may request that assets of a debtor that are located in Switzerland be <mark>attached</mark> for a debt that is due and not secured by a pledge: 1. if the debtor has no fixed domicile; 2. if the debtor, with the intention of evading the fulfilment of his obligations, removes assets, absconds or makes preparations to abscond; 3. if the debtor is travelling through or is a person who visits fairs and markets, for claims which by their nature must be settled immediately; 4. if the debtor does not reside in Switzerland, no other grounds for attachment exist, but the claim has a sufficient connection to Switzerland or is based on an acknowledgement of debt within the meaning of Article 82 paragraph 1; 5. if the creditor holds a provisional or definitive unpaid debt certificate against the debtor; 6. if the creditor has a court judgment or equivalent pursuant to Article 80.

resume: The professional secrecy of bankers, protected by criminal law.
title: Bankgeheimnis in English: banking secrecy · Neur.on
description: Bankgeheimnis in English is banking secrecy (secret bancaire, segreto bancario): the professional secrecy of Swiss bankers under Art. 47 BankA.
lead: Swiss banking secrecy is not a business practice: it is a duty, and its wilful breach is a criminal offence. It binds the bank's governing bodies, employees and agents. Banking secrecy is the usual English name: the Banking Act itself speaks of professional secrecy, and Fedlex publishes no English version of the Act.
definition: Banking secrecy is the duty of a bank's governing bodies, employees, agents and liquidators not to disclose secrets confided to them, or learned by them, in that capacity. The Banking Act makes wilful breach a criminal offence, and negligent breach is also punishable. It does not override statutory duties to testify or to provide information to an authority, such as the duty to report suspected money laundering.
source: Fedlex (German text), loi fédérale sur les banques et les caisses d'épargne

exemple.de: Mit Freiheitsstrafe bis zu drei Jahren oder Geldstrafe wird bestraft, wer vorsätzlich: a. ein <mark>Geheimnis</mark> offenbart, das ihm in seiner Eigenschaft als Organ, Angestellter, Beauftragter oder Liquidator einer Bank oder einer Person nach Artikel 1b oder als Organ oder Angestellter einer Prüfgesellschaft anvertraut worden ist oder das er in dieser Eigenschaft wahrgenommen hat; b. zu einer solchen Verletzung des Berufsgeheimnisses zu verleiten sucht; c. ein ihm nach Buchstabe a offenbartes Geheimnis weiteren Personen offenbart oder für sich oder einen anderen ausnützt.
exemple.fr: Est puni d’une peine privative de liberté de trois ans au plus ou d’une peine pécuniaire celui qui, intentionnellement: a. révèle un <mark>secret</mark> à lui confié ou dont il a eu connaissance en sa qualité d’organe, d’employé, de mandataire ou de liquidateur d’une banque ou d’une personne au sens de l’art. 1b, ou encore d’organe ou d’employé d’une société d’audit; b. tente d’inciter autrui à commettre une telle violation du secret professionnel; c. révèle un secret qui lui a été confié au sens de la let. a ou exploite ce secret à son profit ou au profit d’un tiers.
exemple.it: È punito con una pena detentiva sino a tre anni o con una pena pecuniaria chiunque, intenzionalmente: a. rivela un <mark>segreto</mark> che gli è confidato o di cui ha notizia nella sua qualità di membro di un organo, impiegato, mandatario o liquidatore di una banca o di una persona di cui all’articolo 1b, o di membro di un organo o impiegato di una società di audit; b. ovvero tenta di indurre a siffatta violazione del segreto professionale; c. divulga un segreto che gli è stato rivelato ai sensi della lettera a, oppure lo sfrutta per sé o per altri.

resume: An act aimed at frustrating the identification of assets of criminal origin.
title: Geldwäscherei in English: money laundering · Neur.on
description: Geldwäscherei in English is money laundering (blanchiment d'argent, riciclaggio di denaro): the offence in Art. 305bis SCC, in four languages.
lead: The Swiss German term is Geldwäscherei, not Geldwäsche as in Germany: the variant alone is a marker of the text's source. The offence is set out in the Swiss Criminal Code.
definition: Money laundering means carrying out an act aimed at frustrating the identification of the origin, the tracing or the forfeiture of assets. The offender must know or must reasonably believe that the assets originate from a felony or an aggravated tax misdemeanour. Besides this offence in the Swiss Criminal Code, financial intermediaries are subject to due diligence obligations and a duty to report.

exemple.de: Ein schwerer Fall liegt insbesondere vor, wenn der Täter: a. als Mitglied einer kriminellen oder terroristischen Organisation (Art. 260ter) handelt; b. als Mitglied einer Bande handelt, die sich zur fortgesetzten Ausübung der <mark>Geldwäscherei</mark> zusammengefunden hat; c. durch gewerbsmässige Geldwäscherei einen grossen Umsatz oder einen erheblichen Gewinn erzielt.
exemple.fr: Le cas est grave, notamment lorsque le délinquant: a. agit comme membre d’une organisation criminelle ou terroriste (art. 260ter); b. agit comme membre d’une bande formée pour se livrer de manière systématique au <mark>blanchiment d’argent</mark>; c. réalise un chiffre d’affaires ou un gain importants en faisant métier de blanchir de l’argent.
exemple.it: Vi è caso grave segnatamente se l’autore: a. agisce come membro di un’organizzazione criminale o terroristica (art. 260ter); b. agisce come membro di una banda costituitasi per esercitare sistematicamente il <mark>riciclaggio</mark>; c. realizza una grossa cifra d’affari o un guadagno considerevole facendo mestiere del riciclaggio.
exemple.en: A serious case is constituted, in particular, where the offender: a. acts as a member of a criminal or terrorist organisation; b. acts as a member of a group that has been formed for the purpose of the continued conduct of <mark>money laundering</mark> activities; or c. achieves a large turnover or substantial profit through commercial money laundering.

resume: The document required before a public offer of securities.
title: Prospekt in English: prospectus · Neur.on
description: Prospekt in English is prospectus (prospetto in Italian): the document required before a public offer of securities in Switzerland, under the FinSA.
lead: A prospectus must be published before any public offer of securities in Switzerland. It is one of the most frequently translated financial documents, often under tight deadlines. The Financial Services Act allows it to be drawn up in English as well as in an official language.
definition: A prospectus is the document that any person who makes a public offer in Switzerland for the acquisition of securities must first publish. The same applies to any person who seeks the admission of securities to trading on a trading venue. It contains the essential information on the issuer, the securities offered and the risks, as required by the Financial Services Act. As a rule, it is checked by a reviewing body before publication.

exemple.de: Wer in der Schweiz ein öffentliches Angebot zum Erwerb von Effekten unterbreitet oder wer um Zulassung von Effekten zum Handel auf einem Handelsplatz nach Artikel 26 Buchstabe a FinfraG ersucht, hat vorgängig einen <mark>Prospekt</mark> zu veröffentlichen.
exemple.fr: Quiconque en Suisse soumet une offre au public en vue de l’acquisition de valeurs mobilières ou demande que des valeurs mobilières soient admises à la négociation sur une plate-forme de négociation au sens de l’art. 26, let. a, LIMF doit publier au préalable un <mark>prospectus</mark>.
exemple.it: Chi, in Svizzera, offre al pubblico l’acquisto di valori mobiliari o fa richiesta di ammissione al commercio di valori mobiliari presso una sede di negoziazione secondo l’articolo 26 lettera a LInFi, deve pubblicare previamente un <mark>prospetto</mark>.
exemple.en: Any person in Switzerland who makes a public offer for the acquisition of securities or any person who seeks the admission of securities to trading on a trading venue in accordance with Article 26 letter a of the FinMIA must first publish a <mark>prospectus</mark>.

resume: The private tribunal chosen by the parties to decide a dispute.
title: Schiedsgericht in English: arbitral tribunal · Neur.on
description: Schiedsgericht in English is arbitral tribunal (tribunal arbitral, tribunale arbitrale): international arbitration seated in Switzerland under the PILA.
lead: Switzerland is one of the most widely used seats of arbitration in the world. Where the seat is in Switzerland and a party is neither domiciled nor resident there, the chapter of the PILA on international arbitration applies. The Federal Administration's translation says arbitral tribunal, never arbitration court.
definition: An arbitral tribunal is the private tribunal that the parties set up by an arbitration agreement to decide their dispute instead of the state courts. The Federal Act on Private International Law applies where the tribunal has its seat in Switzerland and at least one party is based abroad. That party must have had neither its domicile, nor its habitual residence, nor its seat in Switzerland when the agreement was concluded. The arbitral tribunal decides on its own jurisdiction.
source: Fedlex, Federal Act on Private International Law

exemple.de: Die Bestimmungen dieses Kapitels gelten für <mark>Schiedsgerichte</mark> mit Sitz in der Schweiz, sofern wenigstens eine Partei der Schiedsvereinbarung beim Abschluss ihren Wohnsitz, ihren gewöhnlichen Aufenthalt oder ihren Sitz nicht in der Schweiz hatte.
exemple.fr: Les dispositions du présent chapitre s’appliquent à tout arbitrage si le siège du <mark>tribunal arbitral</mark> se trouve en Suisse et si au moins l’une des parties à la convention d’arbitrage n’avait, au moment de la conclusion de celle-ci, ni son domicile, ni sa résidence habituelle, ni son siège en Suisse.
exemple.it: Le disposizioni del presente capitolo si applicano ai <mark>tribunali arbitrali</mark> con sede in Svizzera sempreché, al momento della stipulazione, almeno una parte al patto di arbitrato non avesse né domicilio, né dimora abituale, né sede in Svizzera.
exemple.en: The provisions of this Chapter apply to <mark>arbitral tribunals</mark> that have their seat in Switzerland if, at the time that the arbitration agreement was concluded, at least one of the parties thereto did not have its domicile, its habitual residence or its seat in Switzerland.

resume: The legal remedy that brings a decision before a higher authority.
title: Beschwerde: appeal to the Federal Supreme Court · Neur.on
description: Beschwerde in English is appeal (recours, ricorso), not complaint: the remedy that brings a case before the Swiss Federal Supreme Court, in four languages.
lead: An appeal is the remedy that brings a decision before a higher authority, ultimately the Federal Supreme Court. In Swiss Italian it is called ricorso, and the court is the Tribunale federale. Fedlex has no English version of the Federal Supreme Court Act: appeal is the usual rendering, and complaint would mislead, since in English it starts a civil action.
definition: An appeal is the remedy by which a party challenges a decision before a higher authority. Before the Federal Supreme Court, the law distinguishes in particular between the appeal in civil matters, the appeal in criminal matters and the appeal in public law matters. Each has its own admissibility requirements. As a rule, an appeal lies against decisions of the last cantonal instance.
source: Fedlex (German text), loi sur le Tribunal fédéral

exemple.de: Das Bundesgericht beurteilt <mark>Beschwerden</mark> gegen Entscheide in Zivilsachen.
exemple.fr: Le Tribunal fédéral connaît des <mark>recours</mark> contre les décisions rendues en matière civile.
exemple.it: Il Tribunale federale giudica i <mark>ricorsi</mark> contro le decisioni pronunciate in materia civile.

resume: The public prosecutor's decision that convicts the accused without a full trial.
title: Strafbefehl in English: summary penalty order · Neur.on
description: Strafbefehl in English is summary penalty order (ordonnance pénale, decreto d'accusa): the public prosecutor's decision and the ten days to reject it.
lead: A summary penalty order allows the public prosecutor to impose a sentence without a trial hearing. Its Italian name, decreto d'accusa, has no direct equivalent in the Italian of Italy, which makes it a marker of Swiss law. In English, avoid penalty notice: the Federal Administration's translation says summary penalty order.
definition: A summary penalty order is the decision by which the public prosecutor convicts the accused without court proceedings. It requires that the accused has accepted responsibility for the offence or that the facts are otherwise satisfactorily established. The sentence considered appropriate must also stay within the limits set by the Criminal Procedure Code. The accused may file a written rejection within ten days; otherwise the order becomes a final judgment.

exemple.de: Hat die beschuldigte Person im Vorverfahren den Sachverhalt eingestanden oder ist dieser anderweitig ausreichend geklärt, so erlässt die Staatsanwaltschaft einen <mark>Strafbefehl</mark>, wenn sie, unter Einrechnung einer allfällig zu widerrufenden bedingten Strafe oder bedingten Entlassung, eine der folgenden Strafen für ausreichend hält: a. eine Busse; b. eine Geldstrafe von höchstens 180 Tagessätzen; c. … d. eine Freiheitsstrafe von höchstens 6 Monaten.
exemple.fr: Le ministère public rend une <mark>ordonnance pénale</mark> si, durant la procédure préliminaire, le prévenu a admis les faits ou que ceux-ci sont établis et que, incluant une éventuelle révocation d’un sursis ou d’une libération conditionnelle, il estime suffisante l’une des peines suivantes: a. une amende; b. une peine pécuniaire de 180 jours-amende au plus; c. … d. une peine privative de liberté de six mois au plus.
exemple.it: Se nell’ambito della procedura preliminare i fatti sono stati ammessi dall’imputato oppure sono stati sufficientemente chiariti, il pubblico ministero emette un <mark>decreto d’accusa</mark> qualora, tenuto conto di un’eventuale revoca della sospensione condizionale di una pena o di un’eventuale revoca della liberazione condizionale, ritenga sufficiente una delle seguenti pene: a. una multa; b. una pena pecuniaria non superiore a 180 aliquote giornaliere; c. ... d. una pena detentiva non superiore a sei mesi.
exemple.en: If the accused has accepted responsibility for the offence in the preliminary proceedings or if his or her responsibility has otherwise been satisfactorily established, the public prosecutor shall issue a <mark>summary penalty order</mark> if, having taken account of any suspended sentence or parole order that must be revoked, it regards any of the following sentences as appropriate: a. a fine; b. a monetary penalty of no more than 180 daily penalty units; c. … d. a custodial sentence of no more than 6 months.

resume: Detention ordered during the investigation, before the indictment.
title: Untersuchungshaft in English: remand · Neur.on
description: Untersuchungshaft in English is remand, or pre-trial detention (détention provisoire, carcerazione preventiva): a compulsory measure of Swiss law.
lead: Remand is ordered by the compulsory measures court, not by the public prosecutor alone. It ends when the court of first instance receives the indictment. From then on, the person is held in what the Federal Administration's translation calls preventive detention (Sicherheitshaft).
definition: Remand is the deprivation of liberty ordered during the investigation against an accused who is strongly suspected of a felony or misdemeanour. It requires a serious risk of absconding, collusion or reoffending. It is ordered by the compulsory measures court at the public prosecutor's request, for a limited period that may be extended. It ends at the latest when the court of first instance receives the indictment.

exemple.de: Die <mark>Untersuchungshaft</mark> beginnt mit ihrer Anordnung durch das Zwangsmassnahmengericht und endet mit dem Eingang der Anklage beim erstinstanzlichen Gericht, dem vorzeitigen Antritt einer freiheitsentziehenden Sanktion oder mit der Entlassung der beschuldigten Person während der Untersuchung.
exemple.fr: La <mark>détention provisoire</mark> commence au moment où le tribunal des mesures de contrainte l’ordonne et s’achève lorsque l’acte d’accusation est notifié au tribunal de première instance, que le prévenu est libéré pendant l’instruction ou qu’il commence à purger sa sanction privative de liberté de manière anticipée.
exemple.it: La <mark>carcerazione preventiva</mark> comincia quando è disposta dal giudice dei provvedimenti coercitivi e termina con il deposito dell’atto d’accusa presso il tribunale di primo grado, con l’inizio anticipato di una sanzione privativa della libertà o con la liberazione dell’imputato nel corso dell’istruzione.
exemple.en: <mark>Remand</mark> begins when it is ordered by the compulsory measures court and ends with the receipt by the court of first instance of the indictment, the accelerated commencement of a custodial sanction or with the accused's release during the investigation.

resume: The federal tax withheld at source on income from capital.
title: Verrechnungssteuer in English: withholding tax · Neur.on
description: Verrechnungssteuer in English is withholding tax (impôt anticipé, imposta preventiva): the federal tax withheld at source on income from movable capital.
lead: Withholding tax is deducted at source by the payer, then refunded to recipients who properly declare their income. The English name describes the deduction, but the French name, impôt anticipé, does not: a classic translation trap. Fedlex has no English version of the Act; withholding tax is the term used in the English translation of the Federal Constitution.
definition: Withholding tax is a federal tax levied at source on income from movable capital, in particular dividends and interest, and on certain other payments. The payer deducts the tax and pays it to the Confederation. It serves as a guarantee: a recipient domiciled in Switzerland can obtain a refund by correctly declaring the income concerned.
base: Art. 1 Federal Act on Withholding Tax
source: Fedlex (German text), loi fédérale sur l'impôt anticipé

exemple.de: Der Bund erhebt eine <mark>Verrechnungssteuer</mark> auf dem Ertrag beweglichen Kapitalvermögens, auf Gewinnen aus Geldspielen im Sinne des Geldspielgesetzes vom 29. September 2017 (BGS), auf Gewinnen aus Lotterien und Geschicklichkeitsspielen zur Verkaufsförderung, die nach Artikel 1 Absatz 2 Buchstaben d und e BGS diesem nicht unterstehen, und auf Versicherungsleistungen; wo es das Gesetz vorsieht, tritt anstelle der Steuerentrichtung die Meldung der steuerbaren Leistung.
exemple.fr: La Confédération perçoit un <mark>impôt anticipé</mark> sur les revenus de capitaux mobiliers, sur les gains provenant de jeux d’argent au sens de la loi fédérale du 29 septembre 2017 sur les jeux d’argent (LJAr), sur les gains provenant de jeux d’adresse ou de loteries destinés à promouvoir les ventes qui ne sont pas soumis à la LJAr selon l’art. 1, al. 2, let. d et e, de cette loi, ainsi que sur les prestations d’assurances; dans les cas prévus par la loi, la déclaration de la prestation imposable remplace le paiement de l’impôt.
exemple.it: La Confederazione riscuote un’<mark>imposta preventiva</mark> sui redditi di capitali mobili, sulle vincite ai giochi in denaro secondo la legge federale del 29 settembre 2017 sui giochi in denaro (LGD), sulle vincite ai giochi di destrezza e alle lotterie destinati a promuovere le vendite che secondo l’articolo 1 capoverso 2 lettere d ed e LGD non sottostanno a quest’ultima e sulle prestazioni d’assicurazione; nei casi previsti dalla legge, la notifica della prestazione imponibile sostituisce il pagamento dell’imposta.

resume: The general consumption tax, with input tax deduction.
title: Mehrwertsteuer in English: value added tax (VAT) · Neur.on
description: Mehrwertsteuer in English is value added tax: the Swiss general consumption tax and its abbreviations MWST, TVA, IVA and VAT in the four languages.
lead: Swiss VAT is a general consumption tax levied at every stage, with input tax deduction. The abbreviation changes with the language: MWST in German, TVA in French, IVA in Italian, VAT in English. The German abbreviation is never used in a French text.
definition: Value added tax is a general consumption tax that the Confederation levies at every stage of production and distribution, with input tax deduction. It applies to supplies made on Swiss territory by taxable persons, to the acquisition of supplies from businesses domiciled abroad and to the import of goods. Taxable persons account for it periodically to the Federal Tax Administration.

exemple.de: Der Bund erhebt eine allgemeine Verbrauchssteuer nach dem System der Netto-Allphasensteuer mit Vorsteuerabzug (<mark>Mehrwertsteuer</mark>). Die Steuer bezweckt die Besteuerung des nicht unternehmerischen Endverbrauchs im Inland.
exemple.fr: La Confédération perçoit, à chaque stade du processus de production et de distribution, un impôt général sur la consommation (<mark>taxe sur la valeur ajoutée</mark>, TVA), avec déduction de l’impôt préalable. La TVA a pour but d’imposer la consommation finale non entrepreneuriale sur le territoire suisse.
exemple.it: La Confederazione riscuote in ogni fase del processo di produzione e di distribuzione un’imposta generale sul consumo con deduzione dell’imposta precedente (<mark>imposta sul valore aggiunto</mark>, IVA). Lo scopo dell’imposta è l’imposizione del consumo finale non imprenditoriale sul territorio svizzero.
exemple.en: The Confederation shall levy a general consumption tax based on the system of net all-phase taxation with input tax deduction (<mark>Value Added Tax</mark>). The purpose of the tax is to tax non-business end use on Swiss territory.

resume: The act by which an authority decides an individual case under public law.
title: Verfügung in English: ruling, not order · Neur.on
description: Verfügung in English is ruling (décision, decisione): the individual administrative act under Art. 5 APA, its elements and the term in four languages.
lead: A ruling is the act that decides an individual case under federal public law. Calling a letter a ruling is never neutral: it is what opens the legal remedies and starts the time limit for an appeal. Fedlex says ruling, not order or decree; a decision of a court is a decision or a judgment.
definition: Rulings are decisions of the authorities in individual cases that are based on federal public law. Their subject matter is the establishment, amendment or withdrawal of rights or obligations, a finding of the existence or extent of rights or obligations, or the rejection or dismissal of applications. A written ruling must state the grounds on which it is based and contain instructions on legal remedies.

exemple.de: Als <mark>Verfügungen</mark> gelten Anordnungen der Behörden im Einzelfall, die sich auf öffentliches Recht des Bundes stützen und zum Gegenstand haben: a. Begründung, Änderung oder Aufhebung von Rechten oder Pflichten; b. Feststellung des Bestehens, Nichtbestehens oder Umfanges von Rechten oder Pflichten; c. Abweisung von Begehren auf Begründung, Änderung, Aufhebung oder Feststellung von Rechten oder Pflichten oder Nichteintreten auf solche Begehren.
exemple.fr: Sont considérées comme <mark>décisions</mark> les mesures prises par les autorités dans des cas d’espèce, fondées sur le droit public fédéral et ayant pour objet: a. de créer, de modifier ou d’annuler des droits ou des obligations; b. de constater l’existence, l’inexistence ou l’étendue de droits ou d’obligations; c. de rejeter ou de déclarer irrecevables des demandes tendant à créer, modifier, annuler ou constater des droits ou obligations.
exemple.it: Sono <mark>decisioni</mark> i provvedimenti delle autorità nel singolo caso, fondati sul diritto pubblico federale e concernenti: a. la costituzione, la modificazione o l’annullamento di diritti o di obblighi; b. l’accertamento dell’esistenza, dell’inesistenza o dell’estensione di diritti o di obblighi; c. il rigetto o la dichiarazione d’inammissibilità d’istanze dirette alla costituzione, alla modificazione, all’annullamento o all’accertamento di diritti o di obblighi.
exemple.en: <mark>Rulings</mark> are decisions of the authorities in individual cases that are based on the public law of the Confederation and have as their subject matter the following: a. the establishment, amendment or withdrawal of rights or obligations; b. a finding of the existence, non-existence or extent of rights or obligations; c. the rejection of applications for the establishment, amendment, withdrawal or finding of rights or obligations, or the dismissal of such applications without entering into the substance of the case.

resume: Any information relating to an identifiable natural person.
title: Personendaten in English: personal data · Neur.on
description: Personendaten in English is personal data (données personnelles, dati personali): the definition in the Swiss Data Protection Act, in four languages.
lead: The Swiss Data Protection Act now protects natural persons only. Its definition of personal data governs the whole framework, including the rules on processing assigned to processors.
definition: Personal data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. The Act also defines sensitive personal data, which call for stronger safeguards. Examples are data on religious or political views, on health or the private sphere, or on administrative and criminal proceedings or sanctions. Processing must be lawful, carried out in good faith and proportionate.

exemple.de: In diesem Gesetz bedeuten: a. <mark>Personendaten</mark>: alle Angaben, die sich auf eine bestimmte oder bestimmbare natürliche Person beziehen;
exemple.fr: On entend par: a. <mark>données personnelles</mark>: toutes les informations concernant une personne physique identifiée ou identifiable;
exemple.it: Nella presente legge s’intende per: a. <mark>dati personali</mark>: tutte le informazioni concernenti una persona fisica identificata o identificabile;
exemple.en: In this Act: a. <mark>personal data</mark> means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person;

resume: The contract by which an insurer covers a risk in return for a premium.
title: Versicherungsvertrag in English: insurance contract · Neur.on
description: Versicherungsvertrag in English is insurance contract (contrat d'assurance, contratto d'assicurazione), under the Federal Act on Contracts of Insurance.
lead: Private insurance contracts are governed by a federal Act separate from the Code of Obligations. The general insurance conditions are the most translated part, and the most sensitive to terminology gaps. Fedlex has no English version of that Act, so insurance contract is a usage term: the binding wording is Versicherungsvertrag, contrat d'assurance or contratto d'assicurazione.
definition: An insurance contract is a contract by which the insurance company undertakes, in return for a premium, to provide the agreed benefit when the insured event occurs. It is governed by the Federal Act on Contracts of Insurance, supplemented by the Code of Obligations. The policyholder must disclose the facts that are material to the assessment of the risk, and the insurer must provide the general insurance conditions before the contract is concluded.
base: Art. 1 Federal Act on Contracts of Insurance
source: Fedlex (German text), loi fédérale sur le contrat d'assurance

exemple.de: Wer dem Versicherungsunternehmen den Antrag zum Abschlusse eines <mark>Versicherungsvertrages</mark> gestellt und für die Annahme keine kürzere Frist gesetzt hat, bleibt 14 Tage gebunden.
exemple.fr: Celui qui fait à l’entreprise d’assurance une proposition de <mark>contrat d’assurance</mark> est lié pendant quatorze jours s’il n’a pas fixé un délai plus court pour l’acceptation.
exemple.it: Chi ha fatto all’assicuratore la proposta d’un <mark>contratto di assicurazione</mark> rimane vincolato per quattordici giorni, quando non abbia fissato un termine più breve per l’accettazione.

resume: The notice of termination that ends a contract of unlimited duration when the notice period expires.
lead: In Swiss employment law, termination, which the Code of Obligations also calls notice of termination, ends a contract of unlimited duration when the notice period expires. No reasons need be given unless the other party asks for them. In English, terminate is the verb for kündigen: cancel and rescind have other meanings.
definition: An employment contract of unlimited duration may be terminated by either party. Termination is a unilateral declaration that takes effect when the statutory or contractual notice period expires. The party giving notice of termination must state the reasons in writing if the other party so requests. The Code of Obligations also protects employees against wrongful termination and against termination at an inopportune juncture.
title: Kündigung: termination of an employment contract · Neur.on
description: Kündigung in English is termination (résiliation, disdetta), not cancellation: ending an employment contract of unlimited duration under Art. 335 CO.

exemple.de: Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis kann von jeder Vertragspartei <mark>gekündigt</mark> werden.
exemple.fr: Le contrat de durée indéterminée peut être <mark>résilié</mark> par chacune des parties.
exemple.it: Il rapporto di lavoro di durata indeterminata può essere <mark>disdetto</mark> da ciascuna delle parti.
exemple.en: An employment relationship for an unlimited period may be <mark>terminated</mark> by either party.

resume: The termination of an employment contract without notice, for good cause.
lead: Both employer and employee may terminate the employment contract with immediate effect, at any time, for good cause. The court determines at its discretion whether good cause exists. Summary dismissal, the usual English expression, only covers termination by the employer, whereas the Swiss rule applies to both parties.
definition: Good cause means any circumstance that, in good faith, makes it unconscionable for the party giving notice to continue the employment relationship. The terminating party must give its reasons in writing if the other party so requests. An unjustified termination with immediate effect still ends the contract, but the employer must pay what the employee would have earned until the end of the notice period. The court may also award compensation.
title: fristlose Kündigung: immediate termination · Neur.on
description: fristlose Kündigung in English is termination with immediate effect (résiliation immédiate, risoluzione immediata): good cause under Art. 337 CO.

exemple.de: Aus wichtigen Gründen kann der Arbeitgeber wie der Arbeitnehmer jederzeit das Arbeitsverhältnis <mark>fristlos auflösen</mark>; er muss die fristlose Vertragsauflösung schriftlich begründen, wenn die andere Partei dies verlangt.
exemple.fr: L’employeur et le travailleur peuvent <mark>résilier immédiatement</mark> le contrat en tout temps pour de justes motifs; la partie qui résilie immédiatement le contrat doit motiver sa décision par écrit si l’autre partie le demande.
exemple.it: Il datore di lavoro e il lavoratore possono in ogni tempo <mark>recedere immediatamente</mark> dal rapporto di lavoro per cause gravi; a richiesta dell’altra parte, la risoluzione immediata dev’essere motivata per scritto.
exemple.en: Both employer and employee may <mark>terminate the employment relationship with immediate effect</mark> at any time for good cause; the party doing so must give his reasons in writing at the other party’s request.

resume: The contract by which an employee undertakes to work in the employer's service in return for a salary.
lead: The employment contract is the basic contract of Swiss employment law. The Code of Obligations governs it from Article 319 onwards, with many mandatory rules that protect the employee.
definition: Under an individual employment contract, the employee undertakes to work in the service of the employer for a limited or unlimited period. The employer undertakes to pay a salary based on the time worked or the tasks performed. As a rule, the contract is not subject to any specific formal requirement. The employee's subordination to the employer distinguishes it from a mandate and from a work contract.
title: Arbeitsvertrag in English: employment contract · Neur.on
description: Arbeitsvertrag in English is employment contract (contrat de travail, contratto di lavoro): the individual employment contract of Art. 319 CO.

exemple.de: Durch den <mark>Einzelarbeitsvertrag</mark> verpflichtet sich der Arbeitnehmer auf bestimmte oder unbestimmte Zeit zur Leistung von Arbeit im Dienst des Arbeitgebers und dieser zur Entrichtung eines Lohnes, der nach Zeitabschnitten (Zeitlohn) oder nach der geleisteten Arbeit (Akkordlohn) bemessen wird.
exemple.fr: Par le <mark>contrat individuel de travail</mark>, le travailleur s’engage, pour une durée déterminée ou indéterminée, à travailler au service de l’employeur et celui-ci à payer un salaire fixé d’après le temps ou le travail fourni (salaire aux pièces ou à la tâche).
exemple.it: Il <mark>contratto individuale di lavoro</mark> è quello con il quale il lavoratore si obbliga a lavorare al servizio del datore di lavoro per un tempo determinato o indeterminato e il datore di lavoro a pagare un salario stabilito a tempo o a cottimo.
exemple.en: By means of an <mark>individual employment contract</mark>, the employee undertakes to work in the service of the employer for a limited or unlimited period and the employer undertakes to pay him a salary based on the amount of time he works (time wage) or the tasks he performs (piece work).

resume: The contract by which a landlord grants a tenant the use of an object in exchange for rent.
lead: Swiss legal French says bail à loyer, not contrat de location: it is the term used in the Code of Obligations, which distinguishes it from the usufructuary lease (bail à ferme). The Federal Administration's English translation simply says lease, with landlord or lessor and tenant or lessee.
definition: A lease is a contract by which a landlord grants a tenant the use of an object in exchange for rent. The Code of Obligations has special rules for leases of residential and commercial premises: protection against unfair rents, a form approved by the canton for certain notices, and protection against termination. A usufructuary lease, by contrast, covers a productive object whose fruits or proceeds go to the lessee.
title: Mietvertrag in English: lease · Neur.on
description: Mietvertrag in English is lease (bail à loyer, contratto di locazione): the tenancy contract of Art. 253 CO and its special rules, in the four languages.

exemple.de: Durch den <mark>Mietvertrag</mark> verpflichtet sich der Vermieter, dem Mieter eine Sache zum Gebrauch zu überlassen, und der Mieter, dem Vermieter dafür einen Mietzins zu leisten.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>bail à loyer</mark> est un contrat par lequel le bailleur s’oblige à céder l’usage d’une chose au locataire, moyennant un loyer.
exemple.it: La <mark>locazione</mark> è il contratto per cui il locatore si obbliga a concedere in uso una cosa al conduttore e questi a pagargli un corrispettivo (pigione per gli immobili e nolo per i mobili).
exemple.en: <mark>Leases</mark> are contracts in which a landlord or lessor grants a tenant or lessee the use of an object in exchange for rent.

resume: The position of an obligor who fails to perform a due obligation despite a formal reminder from the obligee.
lead: Default is the key concept for late performance in Swiss law. It triggers default interest and gives the obligee the rights set out in Articles 107 to 109 of the Code of Obligations. The English translation says obligor and obligee here, debtor and creditor elsewhere: both pairs render the same German words.
definition: Where an obligation is due, the obligor is in default as soon as they receive a formal reminder from the obligee. Where a deadline for performance has been set by agreement, or by a duly exercised right of termination, the obligor is automatically in default when it expires. An obligor in default is liable even for accidental damage, and default interest runs on pecuniary debts. Under a bilateral contract, the obligee may set a time limit for performance and then withdraw from the contract.
title: Schuldnerverzug in English: default of the obligor · Neur.on
description: Schuldnerverzug in English is default of the obligor (demeure du débiteur, mora del debitore): the formal reminder under Art. 102 CO and its effects.

exemple.de: Ist eine Verbindlichkeit fällig, so wird der Schuldner durch Mahnung des Gläubigers <mark>in Verzug gesetzt</mark>.
exemple.fr: Le débiteur d’une obligation exigible est <mark>mis en demeure</mark> par l’interpellation du créancier.
exemple.it: Se l’obbligazione è scaduta, il debitore è <mark>costituito in mora</mark> mediante l’interpellazione del creditore.
exemple.en: Where an obligation is due, the obligor is <mark>in default</mark> as soon as he receives a formal reminder from the obligee.

resume: The seller's liability for defects in the object sold and for the qualities warranted.
lead: The warranty protects the buyer against an object that is not worth what was agreed. It requires a prompt inspection and immediate notice to the seller. In English, warranty and guarantee are not synonyms, and the Federal Administration's translation keeps warranty for Gewährleistung.
definition: The seller is liable to the buyer for any breach of warranty of quality. The seller is also liable for any defects that materially or legally negate or substantially reduce the value of the object or its fitness for the designated purpose. Depending on the case, the buyer may rescind the contract of sale or claim a reduction in the price. The warranty requires the buyer to inspect the object and to notify the seller of any defects without delay.
title: Gewährleistung in English: warranty · Neur.on
description: Gewährleistung in English is warranty (garantie, garanzia), not guarantee: the seller's liability for defects in the object sold, under Art. 197 CO.

exemple.de: Liegt ein Fall der <mark>Gewährleistung</mark> wegen Mängel der Sache vor, so hat der Käufer die Wahl, mit der Wandelungsklage den Kauf rückgängig zu machen oder mit der Minderungsklage Ersatz des Minderwertes der Sache zu fordern.
exemple.fr: Dans les cas de <mark>garantie</mark> en raison des défauts de la chose, l’acheteur a le choix ou de faire résilier la vente en exerçant l’action rédhibitoire, ou de réclamer par l’action en réduction de prix une indemnité pour la moins-value.
exemple.it: Quando sia dovuta la <mark>garanzia</mark> pei difetti della cosa, il compratore ha la scelta di chiedere coll’azione redibitoria la risoluzione della vendita o coll’azione estimatoria il risarcimento pel minor valore della cosa.
exemple.en: In claims for breach of <mark>warranty of quality and fitness</mark>, the buyer may sue either to rescind the contract of sale for breach of warranty or to have the sale price reduced by way of compensation for the decrease in the object’s value.

resume: The notice by which the buyer informs the seller without delay of defects in the object received.
lead: The French text of the Code of Obligations says avis au vendeur, while practice says avis des défauts. Without timely notice, the buyer loses their warranty rights: it is one of the rules of Swiss sales law with the heaviest consequences. The English translation simply says notice of defects.
definition: The buyer must inspect the condition of the object received as soon as feasible in the normal course of business. On discovering defects for which the seller is liable under warranty, the buyer must notify the seller without delay. Otherwise the object is deemed accepted, except for defects that a customary inspection would not reveal. For such hidden defects, notice must be given as soon as they are discovered.
title: Mängelrüge in English: notice of defects · Neur.on
description: Mängelrüge in English is notice of defects (avis au vendeur, avviso al venditore): the buyer's duty to inspect and give notice without delay, Art. 201 CO.

exemple.de: Der Käufer soll, sobald es nach dem üblichen Geschäftsgange tunlich ist, die Beschaffenheit der empfangenen Sache prüfen und, falls sich Mängel ergeben, für die der Verkäufer Gewähr zu leisten hat, diesem <mark>sofort Anzeige machen</mark>.
exemple.fr: L’acheteur a l’obligation de vérifier l’état de la chose reçue aussitôt qu’il le peut d’après la marche habituelle des affaires; s’il découvre des défauts dont le vendeur est garant, il doit <mark>l’en aviser sans délai</mark>.
exemple.it: Il compratore deve esaminare lo stato della cosa ricevuta, tosto che l’ordinario andamento degli affari lo consenta, e, se vi scopre difetti di cui il venditore sia responsabile, <mark>dargliene subito notizia</mark>.
exemple.en: The buyer must inspect the condition of the purchased object as soon as feasible in the normal course of business and, if he discovers defects for which the seller is liable under warranty, must <mark>notify him without delay</mark>.

resume: The authority to act on behalf of another person, conferred by the principal, and the document that records it.
lead: Vollmacht is rendered as authority or as power of attorney, depending on whether it refers to the power itself or to the document that confers it. The English translation of the Code of Obligations mainly says authority. In British usage, an attorney is the holder of a power of attorney, not a lawyer.
