definition: The rights and obligations arising from a contract made by an authorised agent in the name of another person accrue to the person represented. Where the authority is conferred by a legal transaction, its scope is determined by that transaction. The principal may restrict or revoke the authority conferred at any time.
title: Vollmacht in English: authority, power of attorney · Neur.on
description: Vollmacht in English is authority, or power of attorney for the document (pouvoirs, procuration, procura): agency under Arts 32 to 34 CO.

exemple.de: Hat der Vertretene die <mark>Vollmacht</mark> ausdrücklich oder tatsächlich kundgegeben, so kann er deren gänzlichen oder teilweisen Widerruf gutgläubigen Dritten nur dann entgegensetzen, wenn er ihnen auch diesen Widerruf mitgeteilt hat.
exemple.fr: Lorsque le représenté a fait connaître, soit en termes exprès, soit par ses actes, les <mark>pouvoirs</mark> qu’il a conférés, il ne peut en opposer aux tiers de bonne foi la révocation totale ou partielle que s’il a fait connaître également cette révocation.
exemple.it: Il mandante che ha fatto conoscere in termini espressi o con fatti concludenti le <mark>facoltà</mark> da lui conferite, non può opporre ai terzi di buona fede la revoca totale o parziale, ove non l’abbia loro parimente fatta conoscere.
exemple.en: Where the represented party has expressly or de facto announced the <mark>authority</mark> he has conferred, he may not invoke its total or partial revocation against a third party acting in good faith unless he has likewise announced such revocation.

resume: A company whose nominal capital is divided into capital contributions and which is liable for its obligations only to the extent of its own assets.
lead: GmbH in German, Sàrl in French, Sagl in Italian: the limited liability company is the preferred form of Swiss SMEs, with a minimum nominal capital of 20,000 francs. In English the abbreviation stays as registered, never Ltd.
definition: A limited liability company is a company with separate legal personality and a personal character, in which one or more persons or commercial enterprises participate. Its nominal capital is specified in the articles of association, and it is liable for its obligations only to the extent of its own assets. The nominal capital must amount to at least 20,000 francs. The articles of association may require company members to make additional financial and material contributions.
title: GmbH in English: limited liability company · Neur.on
description: GmbH in English is limited liability company (Sàrl in French, Sagl in Italian), never Ltd: the Swiss company form of Art. 772 CO, in four languages.

exemple.de: Die <mark>Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung</mark> ist eine personenbezogene Kapitalgesellschaft, an der eine oder mehrere Personen oder Handelsgesellschaften beteiligt sind. Ihr Stammkapital ist in den Statuten festgelegt. Für ihre Verbindlichkeiten haftet nur das Gesellschaftsvermögen.
exemple.fr: La <mark>société à responsabilité limitée</mark> est une société de capitaux à caractère personnel que forment une ou plusieurs personnes ou sociétés commerciales. Son capital social est fixé dans les statuts. Ses dettes ne sont garanties que par l’actif social.
exemple.it: La <mark>società a garanzia limitata</mark> è una società di capitali di carattere personale cui partecipano una o più persone o società commerciali. Il capitale sociale è stabilito nello statuto. Per i debiti risponde soltanto il patrimonio sociale.
exemple.en: A <mark>limited liability company</mark> is a company with separate legal personality in which one or more persons or commercial enterprises participate. Its nominal capital is specified in the articles of association. It is liable for its obligations to the extent of the company assets.

resume: A company's founding document, which sets out in particular its business name, seat, objects and capital.
lead: The articles of association are the founding charter of a company limited by shares, a limited liability company or a cooperative. The Code of Obligations sets their minimum content and how they may be amended. Statutes is a false friend: in English it means acts of parliament.
definition: The articles of association are adopted when the company is founded and are filed with the commercial register. For a company limited by shares, they must contain at least the following: the business name and seat; the objects of the company; the share capital and the extent to which it is paid up; the number, nominal value and types of shares. Amendments are, as a rule, resolved by the general meeting and must be done as a public deed.
title: Statuten in English: articles of association · Neur.on
description: Statuten in English is articles of association (statuts, statuto), never statutes: the content required for a company limited by shares by Art. 626 CO.

exemple.de: Die <mark>Statuten</mark> müssen Bestimmungen enthalten über: 1. die Firma und den Sitz der Gesellschaft; 2. den Zweck der Gesellschaft; 3. die Höhe und die Währung des Aktienkapitals sowie den Betrag der darauf geleisteten Einlagen; 4. Anzahl, Nennwert und Art der Aktien; 5. und 6. … 7. die Form der Mitteilungen der Gesellschaft an ihre Aktionäre.
exemple.fr: Les <mark>statuts</mark> doivent contenir des dispositions sur: 1. la raison sociale et le siège de la société; 2. le but de la société; 3. le montant du capital-actions, la monnaie dans laquelle il est fixé et le montant des apports effectués; 4. le nombre, la valeur nominale et l’espèce des actions; 5. et 6. … 7. la forme des communications de la société à ses actionnaires.
exemple.it: Lo <mark>statuto</mark> deve contenere disposizioni sui punti seguenti: 1. la ditta e la sede della società; 2. lo scopo della società; 3. l’ammontare e la moneta del capitale azionario, nonché l’ammontare dei conferimenti effettuati; 4. il numero, il valore nominale e la specie delle azioni; 5. e 6. … 7. la forma delle comunicazioni della società agli azionisti.
exemple.en: The <mark>articles of association</mark> must contain provisions concerning: 1. the business name and seat of the company; 2. the objects of the company; 3. the total share capital, its currency, and the extent to which it is paid up; 4. the number, nominal value and types of shares; 5. and 6. ... 7. the form of the company’s communications with its shareholders.

resume: The capital of a company limited by shares, divided into shares and set in the articles of association.
lead: The share capital of a Swiss company limited by shares amounts to at least 100,000 francs. Since 2023, it may also be set in a foreign currency required for the company's business operations.
definition: Share capital is the capital set in the articles of association of a company limited by shares and divided into shares. It must amount to at least 100,000 francs. Since the revised company law came into force on 1 January 2023, it may also be denominated in a foreign currency. When the company is founded, at least 20% of the nominal value of each share must be paid up, and the contributions must total at least 50,000 francs.
title: Aktienkapital in English: share capital · Neur.on
description: Aktienkapital in English is share capital (capital-actions, capitale azionario): the capital of a Swiss company limited by shares under Art. 621 CO.

exemple.de: Das <mark>Aktienkapital</mark> beträgt mindestens 100 000 Franken.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>capital-actions</mark> ne peut être inférieur à 100 000 francs.
exemple.it: Il <mark>capitale azionario</mark> non può essere inferiore a 100 000 franchi.
exemple.en: The <mark>share capital</mark> amounts to at least 100,000 francs.

resume: The public register that records rights in immovable property.
lead: In Switzerland, ownership of land is as a rule acquired by entry in the land register. The register is public and protects those who rely on it in good faith. In French documents, immeuble is a false friend: it means immovable property, not only a building.
definition: The land register is kept as a record of rights in immovable property. It consists of the main register, the supplementary documents (plans, property directories, supporting documents and property descriptions) and the journal. Ownership and other rights in rem in land are as a rule acquired by entry in the register. A person who acquires a right in good faith in reliance on an entry is protected. Any person showing a legitimate interest may consult the register.
title: Grundbuch in English: land register · Neur.on
description: Grundbuch in English is land register (registre foncier, registro fondiario): the register of rights in immovable property under Art. 942 CC.

exemple.de: Über die Rechte an den Grundstücken wird ein <mark>Grundbuch</mark> geführt.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>registre foncier</mark> donne l’état des droits sur les immeubles.
exemple.it: È istituito un <mark>registro</mark> dei diritti sui fondi.
exemple.en: The <mark>land register</mark> is kept as a record of property rights.

resume: The share of an estate that the law guarantees to certain heirs and of which the deceased cannot deprive them.
lead: Pflichtteil is réserve in Swiss French. Since 1 January 2023, the statutory entitlement has been smaller: descendants are entitled to only half of their statutory succession rights, and parents no longer have one. Forced heirship, the usual comparative-law expression, describes the concept but is not the term used by Fedlex.
definition: The statutory entitlement is the share of the estate of which certain heirs cannot be deprived by a will or a contract of succession, except by disinheritance. The revised law of succession came into force on 1 January 2023. Since then, the statutory entitlement of descendants, like that of a surviving spouse or registered partner, has been one half of their statutory succession rights. Parents no longer have one. The rest forms the disposable part, which the testator may dispose of freely.
title: Pflichtteil in English: statutory entitlement · Neur.on
description: Pflichtteil in English is statutory entitlement (réserve, porzione legittima): the share of an estate protected by Arts 470 and 471 CC, in four languages.

exemple.de: Der <mark>Pflichtteil</mark> beträgt die Hälfte des gesetzlichen Erbanspruchs.
exemple.fr: La <mark>réserve</mark> est de la moitié du droit de succession.
exemple.it: La <mark>porzione legittima</mark> è della metà della quota ereditaria.
exemple.en: The <mark>statutory entitlement</mark> is one-half of the statutory succession rights.

resume: The person appointed by the testator to execute their will.
lead: An executor is appointed by will. The executor administers the estate and takes it through to its division, under the supervision of the authority.
definition: In the will, the testator may appoint one or more persons with capacity to act to execute it. The executor is notified of the appointment ex officio and has 14 days to state whether they accept it; silence is deemed acceptance. The executor administers the estate, settles the debts, distributes the legacies and divides the estate in accordance with the testator's instructions or the law. The executor is entitled to adequate recompense.
title: Willensvollstrecker in English: executor · Neur.on
description: Willensvollstrecker in English is executor (exécuteur testamentaire, esecutore testamentario): appointment and authority under Arts 517 and 518 CC.

exemple.de: Die <mark>Willensvollstrecker</mark> stehen, soweit der Erblasser nichts anderes verfügt, in den Rechten und Pflichten des amtlichen Erbschaftsverwalters.
exemple.fr: Si le disposant n’en a ordonné autrement, les <mark>exécuteurs testamentaires</mark> ont les droits et les devoirs de l’administrateur officiel d’une succession.
exemple.it: Salvo contraria disposizione del testatore, gli <mark>esecutori testamentari</mark> hanno gli stessi diritti e doveri dell’amministratore ufficiale di una successione.
exemple.en: Unless otherwise provided by the testator, the <mark>executors</mark> have the same rights and duties as an official estate administrator.

source: Fedlex, Federal Act on Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy
resume: The court decision that sets aside the debtor's objection so that debt enforcement can continue.
lead: Once the debtor has objected to the summons for payment, debt enforcement is blocked. Setting aside the objection, definitively or provisionally, is the quick way to unblock it. The concept has no common-law counterpart, and Fedlex is not consistent: the DEBA says setting aside the objection, the Civil Procedure Code clearance to proceed.
definition: Where the debtor has objected to the summons for payment, the creditor may apply for the setting aside of the objection. The objection is set aside definitively if the claim is based on an enforceable court judgment or an equivalent title. It is set aside provisionally if the debt enforcement is based on an acknowledgement of debt evidenced by a public deed or confirmed by signature. This does not apply if the debtor immediately enters credible defences that rebut the acknowledgement. The court decides in summary proceedings.
title: Rechtsöffnung: setting aside of the objection · Neur.on
description: Rechtsöffnung in English is setting aside of the objection (mainlevée, rigetto dell'opposizione), definitive or provisional, under Arts 80 to 84 DEBA.

exemple.de: Beruht die Forderung auf einem vollstreckbaren gerichtlichen Entscheid, so kann der Gläubiger beim Richter die Aufhebung des Rechtsvorschlags (definitive <mark>Rechtsöffnung</mark>) verlangen.
exemple.fr: Le créancier qui est au bénéfice d’un jugement exécutoire peut requérir du juge la <mark>mainlevée</mark> définitive de l’opposition.
exemple.it: Se il credito è fondato su una decisione giudiziaria esecutiva, il creditore può chiedere in giudizio il <mark>rigetto</mark> definitivo dell’opposizione.
exemple.en: If the claim is based on an enforceable court judgment, the creditor may request the court to dismiss the objection to the summons for payment (<mark>setting aside the objection</mark> definitively).

source: Fedlex, Federal Act on Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy
resume: The moratorium granted by the court to a debtor in difficulty to restructure or to conclude a composition agreement.
lead: The composition moratorium is the restructuring tool of Swiss law: it protects the debtor from debt enforcement while they negotiate with creditors, under the supervision of a commissioner. The English translation of the DEBA says composition moratorium, that of the Code of Obligations debt restructuring moratorium. The authoritative German, French and Italian texts use a single term.
definition: The debtor, or a creditor entitled to file a bankruptcy petition, may apply to the composition court for a composition moratorium. The court first grants a provisional moratorium of up to four months, which may be extended by up to four more months in justified cases, and as a rule appoints a commissioner. The definitive moratorium is then granted for four to six months. It may be extended to twelve months, or to 24 months in particularly complex cases. During the moratorium, debt enforcement proceedings may in principle neither be initiated nor continued against the debtor.
title: Nachlassstundung in English: composition moratorium · Neur.on
description: Nachlassstundung in English is composition moratorium (sursis concordataire, moratoria concordataria): the restructuring procedure of the DEBA.

exemple.de: Wurde vor der Bewilligung der <mark>Nachlassstundung</mark> die Abtretung einer künftigen Forderung vereinbart, entfaltet diese Abtretung keine Wirkung, wenn die Forderung erst nach der Bewilligung der Nachlassstundung entsteht.
exemple.fr: La cession de créance future conclue avant l’octroi d’un <mark>sursis concordataire</mark> ne déploie pas d’effets si la créance cédée prend naissance après l’octroi du sursis.
exemple.it: La cessione di crediti futuri convenuta prima della concessione della <mark>moratoria concordataria</mark> non esplica alcun effetto se il credito nasce dopo tale concessione.
exemple.en: If the assignment of a future claim was agreed before the <mark>composition moratorium</mark> was authorised, this assignment shall have no effect if the claim only arises after the composition moratorium was authorised.

resume: The measures that the court orders before or during proceedings to protect a right under threat.
lead: Interim measures protect a right before the court decides on the merits. In cases of special urgency, they may be ordered without hearing the opposing party. The English translation says interim measures: an injunction is only one of the measures available.
definition: The court orders the interim measures required where the applicant shows credibly that a right to which they are entitled has been violated or that a violation is anticipated. The violation must also threaten to cause harm that is not easily reparable. The court may in particular issue an injunction, order an unlawful situation to be remedied or give an order to a register authority or a third party. In cases of special urgency, it may order the measure immediately and without hearing the opposing party.
title: vorsorgliche Massnahmen in English: interim measures · Neur.on
description: vorsorgliche Massnahmen in English is interim measures (mesures provisionnelles, provvedimenti cautelari): the rules of Arts 261 to 265 CPC.

exemple.de: Das Gericht trifft die notwendigen <mark>vorsorglichen Massnahmen</mark>, wenn die gesuchstellende Partei glaubhaft macht, dass: a. ein ihr zustehender Anspruch verletzt ist oder eine Verletzung zu befürchten ist; und b. ihr aus der Verletzung ein nicht leicht wieder gutzumachender Nachteil droht.
exemple.fr: Le tribunal ordonne les <mark>mesures provisionnelles</mark> nécessaires lorsque le requérant rend vraisemblable qu’une prétention dont il est titulaire remplit les conditions suivantes: a. elle est l’objet d’une atteinte ou risque de l’être; b. cette atteinte risque de lui causer un préjudice difficilement réparable.
exemple.it: Il giudice ordina i necessari <mark>provvedimenti cautelari</mark> quando l’instante rende verosimile che: a. un suo diritto è leso o è minacciato di esserlo; e b. la lesione è tale da arrecargli un pregiudizio difficilmente riparabile.
exemple.en: The court shall order the <mark>interim measures</mark> required provided the applicant shows credibly that: a. a right to which he or she is entitled has been violated or a violation is anticipated; and b. the violation threatens to cause not easily reparable harm to the applicant.

base: Art. 188 Cst. and Art. 1 Federal Supreme Court Act
resume: The supreme judicial authority of the Confederation, with its seat in Lausanne and divisions in Lucerne.
lead: The same Federal Supreme Court judgment is cited as BGE in German, ATF in French and DTF in Italian. English has no official abbreviation, and English texts keep BGE untranslated.
definition: The Federal Supreme Court is the supreme judicial authority of the Confederation. Its seat is in Lausanne, and its Third and Fourth Public Law Divisions sit in Lucerne (Art. 26 of the Court's internal regulations). It decides in particular on appeals in civil matters, in criminal matters and in public law matters. Its judgments published in the official collection are cited as BGE in German, ATF in French and DTF in Italian.
title: Bundesgericht in English: Federal Supreme Court · Neur.on
description: Bundesgericht in English is Federal Supreme Court (Tribunal fédéral, Tribunale federale), never Federal Court: the supreme court of the Confederation.

exemple.de: Das <mark>Bundesgericht</mark> ist die oberste rechtsprechende Behörde des Bundes.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>Tribunal fédéral</mark> est l’autorité judiciaire suprême de la Confédération.
exemple.it: Il <mark>Tribunale federale</mark> è l’autorità giudiziaria suprema della Confederazione.
exemple.en: The <mark>Federal Supreme Court</mark> is the supreme judicial authority of the Confederation.

resume: The natural person who ultimately controls or benefits from assets.
lead: The beneficial owner is at the heart of the due diligence obligations of Swiss banks: behind every account, the bank must know who really benefits.
definition: The financial intermediary must identify the beneficial owner with the due diligence required in the circumstances. Where the customer is not the beneficial owner, or in case of doubt, it must obtain a written declaration from the customer stating who the beneficial owner of the assets is. For an operating legal entity, it identifies the natural persons who ultimately control it. The identification must be repeated if doubts arise.
title: wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person: beneficial owner · Neur.on
description: wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person in English is beneficial owner (ayant droit économique): identification under Art. 4 AMLA, in four languages.

exemple.de: Der Finanzintermediär muss mit der nach den Umständen gebotenen Sorgfalt die <mark>wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person</mark> feststellen und deren Identität überprüfen, um sich zu vergewissern, wer die wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person ist.
exemple.fr: L’intermédiaire financier doit, avec la diligence requise par les circonstances, identifier l’<mark>ayant droit économique</mark> et vérifier son identité, afin de s’assurer de savoir qui est l’ayant droit économique.
exemple.it: L’intermediario finanziario deve, con la diligenza richiesta dalle circostanze, accertare l’<mark>avente economicamente diritto</mark> e verificarne l’identità, per assicurarsi di sapere chi è l’avente economicamente diritto.
exemple.en: The financial intermediary must identify the <mark>beneficial owner</mark> with the due diligence required in the circumstances and verify its identity in order to ensure that it knows who the beneficial owner is.

resume: The obligations that the Anti-Money Laundering Act imposes on financial intermediaries before and during a business relationship.
lead: The due diligence obligations of the AMLA translate into specific steps: identify, verify, clarify, document. They come before the duty to report. The English translation of the Act also says duties of due diligence; duty of care, a concept from the law of negligence, would be wrong.
definition: The Anti-Money Laundering Act imposes due diligence obligations on financial intermediaries: verifying the identity of the customer, identifying the beneficial owner, repeating these checks if doubts arise, clarifying the economic background and purpose of unusual transactions or business relationships, and keeping records. These obligations are in addition to the duty to report well-founded suspicions to the Money Laundering Reporting Office Switzerland (MROS).
title: Sorgfaltspflichten: due diligence obligations · Neur.on
description: Sorgfaltspflichten in English are due diligence obligations (obligations de diligence, obblighi di diligenza): the AMLA duties of financial intermediaries.

exemple.de: Der Finanzintermediär kann auf die Einhaltung der <mark>Sorgfaltspflichten</mark> (Art. 3-7) verzichten, wenn die Geschäftsbeziehung nur Vermögenswerte von geringem Wert betrifft und keine Verdachtsmomente für mögliche Geldwäscherei oder Terrorismusfinanzierung vorliegen.
exemple.fr: L’intermédiaire financier n’est pas tenu de respecter les <mark>obligations de diligence</mark> (art. 3 à 7) si la relation d’affaires porte uniquement sur des valeurs patrimoniales de faible valeur et qu’il n’y pas d’indices de blanchiment d’argent ou de financement du terrorisme.
exemple.it: L’intermediario finanziario può rinunciare ad adempiere gli <mark>obblighi di diligenza</mark> (art. 3-7) se la relazione d’affari concerne soltanto valori patrimoniali di poca entità e se non vi sono elementi di sospetto di un eventuale riciclaggio di denaro o finanziamento del terrorismo.
exemple.en: The financial intermediary may dispense with complying with the <mark>duties of due diligence</mark> (Art. 3-7) if the business relationship only involves assets of low value and there is no suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing.

source: Fedlex (German text), loi fédérale sur l'impôt fédéral direct
resume: The offence of a taxpayer who, wilfully or negligently, causes an assessment to be omitted or incomplete.
lead: Tax evasion is punished by a tax fine. It is not the same as tax fraud (Steuerbetrug), which involves the use of false documents. Fedlex has no English version of the Federal Act on Direct Federal Taxation, and the English term does not cover exactly the same conduct as in UK law: the German, French or Italian term remains the reference.
definition: A taxpayer who, wilfully or negligently, causes an assessment to be omitted when it should have been made, or a legally binding assessment to be incomplete, is liable to a fine. As a rule, the fine equals the amount of tax evaded. It may be reduced to one third in the case of minor fault, or tripled in the case of serious fault.
title: Steuerhinterziehung in English: tax evasion · Neur.on
description: Steuerhinterziehung in English is tax evasion (soustraction d'impôt, sottrazione d'imposta): the offence in Art. 175 DFTA and how it differs from tax fraud.

exemple.de: Zeigt die steuerpflichtige Person erstmals eine <mark>Steuerhinterziehung</mark> selbst an, so wird von einer Strafverfolgung abgesehen (straflose Selbstanzeige), wenn: a. die Hinterziehung keiner Steuerbehörde bekannt ist; b. sie die Verwaltung bei der Festsetzung der Nachsteuer vorbehaltlos unterstützt; und c. sie sich ernstlich um die Bezahlung der geschuldeten Nachsteuer bemüht.
exemple.fr: Lorsque le contribuable dénonce spontanément et pour la première fois une <mark>soustraction d’impôt</mark>, il est renoncé à la poursuite pénale (dénonciation spontanée non punissable), à condition: a. qu’aucune autorité fiscale n’en ait connaissance; b. qu’il collabore sans réserve avec l’administration pour déterminer le montant du rappel d’impôt; c. qu’il s’efforce d’acquitter le rappel d’impôt dû.
exemple.it: Se il contribuente denuncia spontaneamente per la prima volta una <mark>sottrazione d’imposta</mark>, si prescinde dall’aprire un procedimento penale (autodenuncia esente da pena), a condizione che: a. la sottrazione d’imposta non sia nota ad alcuna autorità fiscale; b. egli aiuti senza riserve l’amministrazione a determinare l’ammontare dell’imposta sottratta; e c. si adoperi seriamente per pagare l’imposta dovuta.

source: Fedlex (German text), loi fédérale sur l'impôt fédéral direct
resume: The tax deducted directly from certain employees' salaries by their employer.
lead: Tax at source must not be confused with withholding tax: the first applies to the earned income of certain employees, the second to income from capital. No official English version of the Act exists, so tax at source is a working rendering; the binding terms are Quellensteuer, impôt à la source and imposta alla fonte.
definition: Foreign employees who do not hold a settlement permit but are domiciled or resident in Switzerland for tax purposes are subject to a tax deducted at source from their income from employment. The employer deducts the tax from the salary and pays it to the tax authority. Certain persons domiciled abroad, such as cross-border commuters and members of boards of directors, are also subject to it.
title: Quellensteuer in English: tax at source · Neur.on
description: Quellensteuer in English is tax at source (impôt à la source, imposta alla fonte), not withholding tax: the deduction made by the employer under the DFTA.

exemple.de: Arbeitnehmer ohne Niederlassungsbewilligung, die in der Schweiz jedoch steuerrechtlichen Wohnsitz oder Aufenthalt haben, unterliegen für ihr Einkommen aus unselbstständiger Erwerbstätigkeit einer <mark>Quellensteuer</mark>.
exemple.fr: Les travailleurs sans permis d’établissement qui sont domiciliés ou en séjour en Suisse au regard du droit fiscal sont soumis à un <mark>impôt à la source</mark> sur le revenu de leur activité lucrative dépendante.
exemple.it: I lavoratori senza permesso di domicilio che hanno domicilio o dimora fiscale in Svizzera sono assoggettati a un’<mark>imposta alla fonte</mark> per il loro reddito da attività lucrativa dipendente.
